meta.title: Accepting a knockout offer on a stage that is not a knockout is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Trade Request not found”, and never with a server error.
